limitations: No real Groq calls or live Supabase; this is the real local game engine.
Paired seeds share initial RNG, but policies consume future random values differently.
Wilson intervals are descriptive; seed/size-cluster bootstrap accounts for rotated-seat correlation.
Unfinished/failed matches remain in denominators with zero wins. No artificial net-worth winner.
Income/build activity and auction premiums are descriptive, not proof of realized ROI.
Cloud CPU performance does not establish Android performance.
Difficulty ladder and competitive superiority require confidence intervals and sufficient held-out games.
